eligibility_notes: Provisional: calendar says applicants 'normally have a bachelor's degree, or equivalent in computer science or a related field'; admissions page allows exceptional non-CS applicants via work experience, so not a reject. Geography BSc with 5-7 yrs DevOps may qualify case-by-case but math/CS prerequisites (calculus, linear algebra, data structures, OS) are a gap. Nigeria likely needs IELTS/TOEFL. Conditional/qualifying admission possible per calendar. Cybersecurity track is security-focused with a distributed/cloud course. Admission fee and ielts figures not directly confirmed for this program.
